correctness.rationale: Direct derivation of root-state recurrences from all quantified forth/back clauses; special leaf case correct. Path and rooted-star formulas follow exactly. Exhaustive canonical rooted-tree enumeration proves only the small-order maxima, with separate direct mapping verification through order seven. No finite test is taken as proof of infinite assertions.

value.rationale: The intrinsic modal-frame extremal question asks whether a path maximizes the number of (not necessarily onto) quotients into tiny chain frames. The precise failure sizes differ (six versus seven), the first offending shapes are unique, and explicit constructions show that branching creates exponentially more morphisms than the polynomial path counts at every subsequent order. These are sharp structural boundaries with natural parameter choices, not arbitrary fixed graph examples.
